courtyard.comment: Grid coordinates in tiles. Origin tile (0,0) is world origin; +x east, +z south. Courtyard spans x -3..3, z -3..3 (7x7 tiles). Gate at south center (0,3). Interior hall occupies the north strip behind the courtyard's north wall.

wallRuns.comment: interior hall south wall, west of doorway. wall-half.glb is authored 2m wide once normalizeToTile scales off its Z depth (the correct 4x, not the old X-derived 8x) -- half a tile, not a whole one -- so this run steps in half-tiles now. Four pieces at 2m each still span the same 8m this used to cover in two 4m-wide (buggy) pieces.

interior hall south wall, east of doorway. Doorway gap is world x 0..4, unchanged by the scale fix -- wall-half.glb's local x range is 0..0.5 rather than centred, and normalizeToTile re-grounds y but never re-centres x/z, so a piece placed on tile n covers world x 4n..4n+2 now (was 4n..4n+4 before the fix). See the notes file for the scale bug this run used to carry.

interior hall west wall. Same half-tile-step fix as the south wall runs: correctly-scaled wall-half.glb pieces are 2m along their run, so this needs two to close what one (buggy, 4m-appearing) piece used to cover.

interior hall east wall. Same half-tile-step fix as the west wall above, but the step direction flips: a rotationY of 270 vs 90 mirrors which way +tz moves the piece in world space, so this run steps tz negative to reach the outer wall instead of doubling back onto the south partition.

gateDoor.comment: Poly Haven gate mesh seated in the archway; pivots open on quest completion

interiorProps.comment: was tile z -2.5 (world -10), which put the table's own north edge 0.33 m inside the north wall (wall's inner face is world z -10, box was z -10.33..-9.67). Whole hall cluster (this table, the chair, stool, statue, candleholders, lantern) and the Scholar shifted +2.0 m south (+0.5 tile) together as one rigid move so their relative spacing is unchanged; see gothic_statue's comment below for the wall-clearance numbers that picked +2.0
part of the +2.0 m south rigid shift, see WoodenTable_01's comment
part of the +2.0 m south rigid shift, see WoodenTable_01's comment

was tile [-2.2, -2.7] (world -8.8, -10.8) — that box (x -9.257..-8.129, z -11.66..-9.94) sat entirely inside the corner where the north wall (z <= -10) and the hall's own west wall (x <= -6) meet, fully invisible, same class of bug as the statue below but nobody had measured this corner. Needed both an east shift (off the west wall, not just south of the north wall — a south-only shift walks it into the west wall's z-band instead) and the same +0.5 tile south shift as the rest of the cluster. +1.1 tile east (4.4 m) clears the west wall by just over its own footprint and stays clear of the hall's west column (world x -6..-5.2, z -10..-9.2, right in the naive path east)

was tile [2.2, -2.7] (world 8.8, -10.8), entirely inside the north wall (z <= -10), same discovery as GothicCabinet_01 mirrored onto the east wall/east column — see its comment. Mirrored shift: 1.1 tile (4.4 m) west, 0.5 tile south

was tile z -2.85 (world -11.4): measured box z -11.774..-10.211, entirely inside the north wall (inner face z -10) -- confirmed invisible with a camera probe standing where it should render. The whole hall cluster (this statue, the table, chair, stool, candleholders, lantern) and the Scholar (data/npcs.json, and SCHOLAR in Tools/board-check/play-castle.mjs) moved +2.0 m south (+0.5 tile) as one rigid shift, chosen as the smallest round number that clears the statue's north edge (0.23 m margin from the wall) without pushing the chair's south edge past the doorway partition (0.76 m margin from its inner face at z -6) -- valid range was roughly +1.9 to +2.6 m

lantern on the table. yOffset is a lift ABOVE whatever castle-builder finds underneath, so a tabletop item wants no yOffset at all — it used to carry 0.95 against a 0.55 m table and hung in the air. Tile z was -2.48 (world -9.92); its own box clipped 0.03 m into the north wall even sitting on the table, since the table's own north edge already did. Part of the +2.0 m south rigid shift, see gothic_statue's comment

a 1.08 m spread of three candlesticks, not one object. At tile x -0.2 the westmost one overhung the table by 0.35 m; -0.1 puts the whole spread on it. Tile z was -2.48 (world -9.92); its own box clipped 0.25 m into the north wall. Part of the +2.0 m south rigid shift, see gothic_statue's comment
wall dressing near the Guard's post. Nothing underneath it, so the 1.2 lift is measured off the ground and still means what it says

braziers.comment: flicker light flanking the gate, west. z was 2.7 -> world 10.8, which is INSIDE the south wall: those blocks span z 10..14 and x -14..-2 / 2..14, so both gate braziers stood in solid stone. A PointLight is not occluded by geometry here, so they lit the courtyard perfectly and nothing looked wrong until they got a body. 2.35 -> world 9.4 puts the bowl 0.31 m clear of the wall's inner face
flicker light flanking the gate, east

hall doorway light, against the east jamb. The doorway gap is world x 0..4, NOT -2..2: wall-half.glb is authored off-centre (local x 0..0.5) and normalizeToTile only re-grounds y, so each piece extends a full tile east of the tile it is placed on. This brazier was at world x 0, i.e. flush inside the west jamb. x 3.4 keeps it out of the stone and 1.1 m off the line the player walks to reach the Scholar
